description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class SuiteLoggerTest that tests the SuiteLogger utility class for logging functionalities within the SuiteCRM project. The tests cover various log levels, message interpolation, and setup/teardown procedures.

classes.name: SuiteLoggerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the SuiteLogger utility functions, including log message output at various levels and setup/teardown functionality.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment, initializes the SuiteLogger instance, and sets the log level to debug.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Restores the previous log level, cleans up the SuiteLogger instance, and performs cleanup after each test.

methods.name: testLogEmergency
methods.description: Tests logging an emergency message and verifies the last log line contains the correct level.

methods.name: testLogAlert
methods.description: Tests logging an alert message and verifies the last log line contains the correct level.

methods.name: testLogCritical
methods.description: Tests logging a critical message and verifies the last log line contains the correct level.

methods.name: testLogError
methods.description: Tests logging an error message and verifies the last log line contains the correct level.

methods.name: testLogWarning
methods.description: Tests logging a warning message and verifies the last log line contains the correct level.

methods.name: testLogNotice
methods.description: Tests logging a notice message and verifies the last log line contains the correct level.

methods.name: testLogInfo
methods.description: Tests logging an info message and verifies the last log line contains the correct level.

methods.name: testLogDebug
methods.description: Tests logging a debug message and verifies the last log line contains the correct level.

methods.name: testInterpolate
methods.description: Tests message interpolation in log messages.

methods.name: testInvalidLevel
methods.description: Verifies that logging with an invalid level throws an InvalidArgumentException.

methods.name: getLastLogMessage
methods.description: Reads the project log file and retrieves the last log message for verification.
